_note: Stage 1 screening specification. The score is a WORKFLOW PRIORITISATION TOOL only - not a validated susceptibility metric. Hard gates are evaluated first and a high score can never override a FAIL.

Y_GATE.question: Are usable instability labels available?
Y_GATE.PASS: Mapped polygons/points of event or systematic inventory with documented method exist and are obtainable (open, local V1, or a known request route)
Y_GATE.FAIL: No mapped inventory exists, or labels are only reports/paper figures with no recoverable geometry

OMEGA_GATE.question: Can defensible observation/non-event terrain be established?
OMEGA_GATE.PASS: Explicit mapping AOI / imagery footprint / study-area or catchment boundary documented by the producers
OMEGA_GATE.FAIL: Only positives with no documented mapping domain and no defensible independent domain rule
OMEGA_GATE.UNCERTAIN: Domain plausibly recoverable (e.g. described study area, cloud mask, systematic national mapping) but not yet verified
OMEGA_GATE.rule: The bounding box or convex hull of positive polygons is NEVER accepted as Omega_obs

M_GATE.question: Can reliable modern terrain be generated?
M_GATE.PASS: A DEM of adequate resolution whose epoch is valid for the inventory (pre-event or explicitly justified) is available

H_STATUS.question: How viable is H for this landscape?
H_STATUS.PASS: Edifice/plateau/caldera geometry plus controls and geology make an independent reconstruction with uncertainty plausible
H_STATUS.UNCERTAIN: Some H (e.g. time-since-emplacement or partial geometry) possible
H_STATUS.FAIL: No meaningful volcanic history signal can be reconstructed
H_STATUS.NOT_REQUIRED: Landscape intended only for M/E/G experiments
H_STATUS.note: H_STATUS is NOT a critical gate: landscapes without H may still serve M/E/G generalisation experiments. Missing H is never encoded as zero

y_quality.rubric: 3 event/systematic polygon inventory >=1000 features with documented method; 2 smaller or multi-temporal polygons, or points with documented method; 1 small/reported/partial; 0 none/unknown

omega_quality.rubric: 3 explicit published AOI/extent file; 2 documented study area/catchment or systematic coverage without file; 1 only inferable from context; 0 none/unknown

tier1_availability.rubric: 3 explicit source/scarp/initiation layer; 1 initiation points or partial; 0 none/unknown

dem_quality.rubric: 3 national lidar or <=10 m pre-event plausibly available; 2 30 m global pre-event-valid; 1 only post-event/poor; 0 unknown

environment.rubric: 2 global harmonisable layers (default); 3 plus local trigger data (gauges/ShakeMap); 0 none

geology.rubric: 3 digital geology <=1:50k; 2 digital 1:100k-1:500k; 1 only coarse global (GLiM) or paper maps; 0 unknown

unit_age.rubric: 3 unit ages in digital map; 2 published geochronology; 1 relative stratigraphy only; 0 unknown

h_feasibility.rubric: 3 HIGH; 2 MEDIUM; 1 LOW (e.g. time-since-emplacement only, tephra mantle); 0 unavailable/unknown

h_uncertainty.rubric: 3 ensemble demonstrated (V1) or clearly feasible; 2 likely; 1 low; 0 none/unknown

data_accessibility.rubric: 3 open download verified or local V1; 2 open portal unverified; 1 login/request required; 0 paper only / not found / unknown

diversity.rubric: 3 fills an underrepresented continent/setting/climate/trigger; 2 moderate contribution; 1 common category; 0 unknown

score_formula: screening_score = sum_k weight_k * rating_k / 3  (0-100, one decimal)
priority_rule: candidate_class KNOWN_V1 -> KNOWN_V1_DECISION_PENDING (V2 role decided later; V1 files untouched)
volcano_type == NON_VOLCANIC_REFERENCE -> REJECT (outside V2 volcanic scope)
manual_priority_override in {REJECT, HOLD} -> that class (downgrade only; never upgrades; reason recorded in exclusion_reason)
any critical gate (Y_GATE, OMEGA_GATE, M_GATE) == FAIL -> REJECT (score ignored)
Y_GATE == PASS and OMEGA_GATE == PASS and M_GATE == PASS and data_accessibility in {OPEN_DOWNLOAD, VERIFIED_LOCAL_V1} and score >= 55 -> PRIORITY_A
Y_GATE in {PASS, UNCERTAIN} and OMEGA_GATE in {PASS, UNCERTAIN} and M_GATE == PASS and data_accessibility not in {PAPER_ONLY, NOT_FOUND, UNKNOWN} and score >= 40 -> PRIORITY_B

diversity promotion: diversity_value == HIGH and Y_GATE == PASS and OMEGA_GATE != FAIL and M_GATE == PASS and data_accessibility in {OPEN_DOWNLOAD, OPEN_PORTAL_UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED_LOCAL_V1} -> at least PRIORITY_B
